title: Halcyon internal memo
text:
HALCYON BIOTICS · INTERNAL · RESTRICTED

RE: Patient Zero

The asset left the Exec Zone facility at 02:14 with the subject. Recovery of the asset takes priority over recovery of the subject.

The asset's carrier signal will strengthen as the implant degrades. Field teams are to track it and wait. Do not engage third parties unless the asset is at risk.
